answers.text: "Range exit from a flat tide is stage 1 resolving." On my test that is the point: C1/C4 buy the first exit from balance at the Creek, not a mature trend. W HH/HL with ema9 63.28 over ema21 61.84 is a weekly turning up, not down (C16 passes); D close 67.38 over ema9 65.21, H1 97.4% of range. The open leg is C5's hold outside the range, already declared; the trigger requires that follow-through. Not conceded.
